from pathlib import Path
from collections import deque, Counter
program_dir = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source = '''from collections import deque, Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    outside = set()
    q = deque()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in (0, w - 1):
            if grid[r][c] == bg and (r, c) not in outside:
                outside.add((r, c)); q.append((r, c))
    for c in range(w):
        for r in (0, h - 1):
            if grid[r][c] == bg and (r, c) not in outside:
                outside.add((r, c)); q.append((r, c))
    while q:
        r, c = q.popleft()
        for nr, nc in ((r - 1, c), (r + 1, c), (r, c - 1), (r, c + 1)):
            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == bg and (nr, nc) not in outside:
                outside.add((nr, nc)); q.append((nr, nc))
    return [[4 if grid[r][c] == bg and (r, c) not in outside else grid[r][c] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
